run_model_zoo_stats: run the script to generate modelzoo_statistics.md from config README files
extract_checkpoint_urls: extract model checkpoint URLs from markdown README files using regex patterns
aggregate_paper_types: aggregate and count unique paper types across all config README files
parse_readme_titles: parse the first line title from each config directory README markdown file
generate_model_zoo_report: generate a markdown report summarizing papers, checkpoints, and paper type counts
